72b33306: ;If DIR type is INPUT and DIR is not defined or DIR is defined but does not have the NO-INHERIT flag set, display "(No Editing)" and set the response to null.
703d6a81: ;Read the response, X, timing out after DTIME seconds. Set DTOUT if timed out, and set X to the UP-ARROW character. Sound a beep on timeout.
ca4617eb: ;Quit the loop or routine.
8a262a16: Initialize the DQ array and increment the count of DQ nodes.
bf5aad9e: Branch execution to the node identified by the value of DQ.
2edd0e4e: If the DE array has a node for the current DQ value, go to the PR label; otherwise, execute the W and TR routines.
c245d873: If X is empty and DV does not contain 'R', go to the A label; if X is empty and DV contains 'R', go to the X label; if D is greater than 0, go to the X label; otherwise, go to the A label.
0f7cb744: If X starts with '?', go to the QS label; if X starts with '^', execute the D routine and branch to ^DIE17.
721367ca: If X is '@', execute the D routine and branch to Z^DIE2.

575b3d2c: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV does not contain 'P', and there is a node in the ^DISV global for the current user, DLB, and 'DIE', then set X to the value stored in that node. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the value of X preceded by '  '.

5e410f84: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17; if DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3; if DV does not contain 'S', go to the P label. If the DP, DIFLD, and 12.1 nodes are defined in the ^DD global, execute the code stored there. Set % to the part of DU after the first occurrence of ';_X_:', and Y to X. If % is not empty and the DIC('S') code is defined, execute it. If the result is true and DB(DQ) is not defined, write '  ' followed by %,  then go to the V label.

972c2fc3: Loop through the DU string, splitting it on ';'. For each piece, set Y to the piece, and DG to the position of ':_X' within Y. If Y is empty, go to the X label. Set YS to Y, and Y to the part of Y before the first ':'. If DG is non-zero and the DIC('S') code is defined, execute it. If the result is true, quit the loop.
f1beb8e2: If DB(DQ) is not defined, write the part of YS starting at position DG. Set X to the part of YS before the first ':'.
49f29e62: If input transformation fails, quit
159aaf29: If the DB node being accessed is not word-processing (DV["N"), and the transformed data is longer than 24 characters, discard the transformed data

bfc21568: If the input data contains a decimal point and DB node being accessed is not word-processing or computed expression, remove leading and trailing 0s, and convert to numeric if no decimal portion remains
cc2270ec: Execute any executable help messages associated with the DR string
b19ca783: Store transformed data in ^UTILITY if requested, set auditing node if DV["d", quit if input was U (up-arrow)

96811fef: Call the helper function E^DIE0. If variable X is defined, or we are in 'PR' mode, branch to label RD.
1435f373: Exit the current routine.
4b0689ff: Initialize variables DNM (name), DQ (index), and set DQ to 1.
b1eea480: Set field attributes: DW (word-processing field), DV (validation literal), DU (input transform), DLB (label), DIFLD (field number).
39e33f6b: Branch to label RE.
4b094fa4: Label X1 does nothing and exits.

98d38f73: If DG array is defined for more than 9 nodes, call helper F^DIE17 and DE (description). Set Y to unified code U, DQ to 2. Call routine X2. If Y is undefined or equal to U, branch to A. Otherwise, set X to Y, DIC(0) to 'F', DW to DQ. Call OUT^DIE17.
dfdbdbc9: Set the value of the DICTATED REPORT DATE/TIME field in the record being edited to blank, and set the DGJTST and Y variables to indicate a 'dictated' entry.
3462595a: Exit the input logic.

57cbe2c1: Call the DIE17^DIE routine to update the record if the DG array is defined, otherwise call the X3^DIE17 routine, set the Y variable to the up-arrow delimiter, set the DQ variable to 3, and call the X3 routine or exit if Y is undefined or equal to the up-arrow delimiter.
d96c0149: Set the DGJTST variable to 'TRANSCRIBED'.
3f67c39b: Exit the X3 routine.
3798b1f1: Call the F^DIE17 routine to update the record if the DG array is defined, then go to the ^DGJXA13 routine.
